projects.title: Aslsh
projects.description: Aslsh is a lightweight shell implemented in Go, made for educational purposes to help me understand basic shell functionality and system command execution.

projects.title: FlightsASL
projects.description: FastAPI + PostgreSQL service that integrates FlightRadar24 to search airports, ingest and filter arrivals/departures, persist schedules, and serve both REST APIs and Jinja-powered web pages.

projects.title: Hyprland-Rice
projects.description: NixOS flake for a lightweight Hyprland desktop that combines system modules, Home Manager settings, a Quickshell system-info bar, and app configs for Foot, Tofi, Walker and Fastfetch, all managed from a single configuration.

projects.title: notify-telegram-action
projects.description: This GitHub Actions workflow sends a detailed Telegram notification whenever a workflow (such as your tests) finishes running. The notification includes the repository name, commit message, author, workflow name, and the final status (success or failure), helping you easily monitor your project's CI/CD results in real time.

projects.title: upload-to-docker-action
projects.description: GitHub Action that sets up Docker Buildx, logs in to Docker Hub, and builds and pushes multi-platform Docker images with the tags and Dockerfile you choose.
